# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_MOMENTUM_DIVERGENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bearish RSI divergence after 11:00 AM, combined with a bearish EMA ribbon (EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50) and a down-close candle with elevated volume, signals weakening momentum suitable for a short entry. This setup exploits the midday lull (11:00-14:00) when trend-following strategies fade and divergence signals are more reliable in ranging/mildly bearish regimes (VIX > 18). The novelty lies in flipping the existing RSI_DIVERGENCE_BULL_WATCHER to bearish, adding EMA ribbon confirmation, volume filter, and strict time-of-day window to create a distinct short-bias trigger not present in the registry.

## Mechanism

After 11:00 AM ET, scan for: (1) price making a higher high while RSI(14) makes a lower high (bearish divergence), (2) EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50 (bearish ribbon), (3) current candle closing below its open (bearish body), and (4) volume > 1.3 * average volume(20). Enter short at the candle close. Exit: stop placed above the recent swing high (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.75R, runner trailed at 12% off highest-water-mark using a chandelier trail. Avoid strong trending mornings where divergence fails; regime filter requires VIX > 18.
